title: What If Every School on Earth Closed at Once? It Happened

scenes.text: What if every school on Earth closed at once? In 2020, that really happened.
At the April peak, about 1.6 billion students were out of school, over 90 percent of all learners.
More than 190 countries shut schools, and the World Bank warned of around 10 trillion dollars in lost lifetime earnings.
Before the pandemic, 53 percent of children in low and middle income countries were already in what the World Bank calls learning poverty.
For lower secondary students, the share missing minimum skills could jump from 40 to 50 percent.
Just five months out of school cuts about 0.6 years of quality-adjusted learning. That is not a pause. That is a dent.
